prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose How You Want to Meet Your Pet", "Pick a ready-to-adopt companion or create a custom pet from your photos.", "Instant Adoption vs Custom Creation"]
1: ["Signing into your existing account instantly restores all your saved desktop pets."]
2: ["Set Your Pet's Daily Routine", "Choose whether your pet wanders freely, stays near your dock, or sleeps during work hours.", "Desktop Behaviors", "Continue"]
3: ["Use clear, well-lit front photos of your pet for best render accuracy."]
4: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Official Pet Companion Badge"]
5: ["Your Pet is Arriving on Your Desktop", "You can safely minimize this window; we'll alert you the moment your pet appears."]
6: ["Preparing overlay assets and screen bounds"]
7: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Click to pet, drag to move, or right-click to hide your pet anytime.", "Desktop Controls Quick Guide"]
8: ["Tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P or use the system tray icon to summon or hide your pet at any time."]
9: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Companion", "In just a few simple steps, adopt or create a virtual pet that lives right on your desktop screen.", "Start Setup"]
